applies_to.quote: provides information required in relation to the receipt of payment for such services to the Authorised Dealer for crediting the account of the exporter.
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 7, Section 8, sub -section (6) of Section 10 and sub-section (2) of Section 47 of the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999

answer.action: Authorised dealers must process service export EDF submissions and update IDPMS import details for non-individuals meeting value thresholds.
answer.action_quote: shall enter details of import of service in IDPMS, as furnished by the importer who is a person other than a resident individual and where the invoice or the contract value is more than ₹10 Lakh

effective_date.quote: These regulations shall come into force from October 01, 2026.

answer.amends: Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026
